about: Batch 04, slice A, chunk A32: lunches (arepas, pupusas, gozleme, jianbing, katsu sandos, roti wraps, banh mi, rice paper rolls, poke bowls, meal-prep boxes).

recipes.title: Arepa Reina Pepiada (Venezuelan Chicken and Avocado Arepa)
recipes.summary: Griddled cornmeal cakes split and stuffed with a creamy chicken, avocado and lime filling.
steps: Stir the cornmeal, water and salt into a soft dough and rest it for 5 minutes, then shape into 4 thick discs.
Cook the discs in the oil in a frying pan over medium heat for 6 minutes each side, until golden with a hollow sound when tapped.
Mix the chicken, avocado, mayonnaise, lime juice, coriander and spring onion, and season.
Split the arepas, fill with the chicken mixture and eat warm.
notes: Food safety: cook or buy the chicken ready-cooked and keep it chilled until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only). Keep the filling separate from the arepas and eat within 24 hours.
Contains egg (mayonnaise).

recipes.title: Arepas con Caraotas y Queso (Venezuelan Black Bean and Cheese Arepas)
recipes.summary: Crisp cornmeal cakes filled with seasoned black beans and melted mozzarella.
steps: Mix the cornmeal, water and salt into a dough, rest 5 minutes and shape into 4 discs.
Cook in half the oil in a frying pan over medium heat for 6 minutes each side until golden.
Soften the onion and garlic in the remaining oil for 4 minutes, add the beans and cumin and mash lightly while heating through for 5 minutes.
Split the arepas, fill with the beans and mozzarella and serve warm.
notes: Keeps 3 days in the fridge; reheat the filling until steaming hot.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Pupusas de Queso y Frijoles (Salvadoran Bean and Cheese Pupusas)
recipes.summary: Thick griddled corn cakes stuffed with refried beans and melted cheese, served with a quick cabbage slaw.

items: 200g canned black beans, drained and mashed

steps: Mix the cornmeal, water and salt to a soft dough and divide into 4 balls.
Press a hollow into each ball, fill with the mashed beans and mozzarella, close and flatten to 1cm thick discs.
Cook in the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat for 4 minutes each side until blistered and golden.
Toss the cabbage, carrot, vinegar and oregano with a pinch of salt and serve with the pupusas.
notes: Keeps 3 days in the fridge; reheat in a dry pan.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Gozleme with Spinach and Feta (Turkish Filled Flatbread)
recipes.summary: Thin hand-rolled flatbread folded around spinach, feta and herbs, griddled until blistered.
steps: Knead the flour, water, salt and oil into a smooth dough for 5 minutes, then divide into 4 balls.
Wilt the spinach in a hot pan for 2 minutes, squeeze out the water and mix with the feta and spring onion.
Roll each ball very thin, spoon the filling over half, fold over and seal the edges so none can leak.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes each side until blistered and golden, brush with the butter and serve with lemon.
notes: Keeps 2 days in the fridge; reheat in a dry pan.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Gozleme with Spiced Lamb (Turkish Mince Flatbread)
recipes.summary: Rolled flatbread filled with cumin-spiced lamb mince, onion and parsley.
steps: Knead the flour, water, salt and half the oil into a dough and divide into 4 balls.
Brown the lamb with the onion, garlic, cumin and paprika for 8 minutes until cooked through (75°C) and dry, then stir in the parsley and cool slightly.
Roll the dough very thin, fill half of each, fold and seal.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes each side until blistered and golden, and serve with lemon.
notes: Food safety: cook lamb mince until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only).  Cool the filling quickly if making ahead.
Contains gluten.

recipes.title: Gozleme with Potato and Herbs (Turkish Vegan Flatbread)
recipes.summary: A vegan filling of mashed potato, onion and chilli flakes in a thin griddled flatbread.
steps: Knead the flour, water, salt and 1 tbsp oil into a dough and divide into 4 balls.
Boil the potato for 12 minutes, drain and mash with the onion softened in a little oil, chilli, parsley and salt.
Roll the dough thin, fill half of each, fold and seal.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes each side until blistered and golden, and serve with lemon.
notes: Keeps 2 days in the fridge.
Contains gluten.

recipes.title: Jianbing (Chinese Egg Crepe Wrap)
recipes.summary: A street-food crepe with egg, spring onion and sesame, brushed with hoisin and wrapped round a crisp wrapper.
steps: Whisk the flours, water and a pinch of salt into a thin batter.
Fry the wonton wrappers in the oil until crisp, about 1 minute each side, and set aside.
Pour half the batter into a lightly oiled non-stick pan, spread thin, crack an egg on top and spread it, then scatter spring onion and sesame.
Flip, brush with hoisin and chilli sauce, add coriander and two wrappers, fold into a parcel and repeat.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites and yolks are set until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only).  Eat straight away; do not hold at room temperature.
Contains gluten, egg and sesame.

recipes.title: Katsu Sando (Japanese Pork Cutlet Sandwich)
recipes.summary: A panko-crumbed pork cutlet with tangy tonkatsu sauce and shredded cabbage in soft white bread.
steps: Flatten the pork thin, season, then dust with flour, dip in egg and press into the panko.
Shallow-fry in the oil over medium-high heat for 3 to 4 minutes each side until golden and cooked through, then drain and rest 2 minutes.
Mix the mayonnaise into the cabbage and spread the bread with the tonkatsu sauce.
Fill with the cutlets and cabbage, trim the crusts and halve.
notes: Food safety: cook pork to 70°C until the juices run clear and no pink remains until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only).  Best eaten the same day; if packed, keep below 5C for no more than 4 hours.
Contains gluten and egg.

recipes.title: Ebi Katsu Sando (Japanese Prawn Cutlet Sandwich)
recipes.summary: Crumbed prawn cutlets with lemony mayonnaise and cabbage in soft white bread.
steps: Flatten the prawns lightly and form into two patties, dust with flour, dip in egg and coat with panko.
Shallow-fry in the oil over medium-high heat for 3 minutes each side until golden and opaque.
Mix the mayonnaise and lemon juice and toss with the cabbage.
Fill the bread with the cutlets and cabbage and halve.
notes: Food safety: cook prawns until pink and opaque all the way through until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only).  Eat within 4 hours if packed, with an ice pack; do not reheat seafood more than once.
Contains gluten, egg and crustacean shellfish.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Roti Wrap (with Mint Yoghurt)
recipes.summary: Spiced chicken pieces rolled in warm roti with onion, cucumber and mint yoghurt.
steps: Toss the chicken with the garam masala, 1 tbsp yoghurt and a pinch of salt.
Cook in the oil in a hot pan for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Mix the remaining yoghurt with the mint and lemon juice.
Warm the roti, spread with the yoghurt, add chicken, onion and cucumber, and roll.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken to 75C with no pink in the middle until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only).
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Egg Roti Wrap (Malaysian-Style Roti Telur)
recipes.summary: A soft roti wrapped around a spiced onion omelette with chilli sauce.
steps: Beat the eggs with the onion, chilli, turmeric and salt.
Cook half the mixture in the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat, 3 minutes, until set, and repeat.
Warm the roti, lay an omelette on each pair, add chilli sauce and cucumber.
Roll tightly, tucking in the ends, and serve warm or halved.
notes: Food safety: cook the omelettes until fully set with no runny egg until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only).  Eat the same day; if packed, keep chilled and eat within 4 hours.
Contains gluten and egg.

recipes.title: Tofu Banh Mi (Vietnamese Lemongrass Tofu Baguette)
recipes.summary: Crisp lemongrass tofu in a baguette with quick-pickled carrot, cucumber and coriander.
steps: Press the tofu dry and marinate in the soy sauce and lemongrass while you pickle.
Toss the carrot with the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt.
Fry the tofu in the oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes each side until golden.
Split the baguettes, fill with tofu, pickled carrot, cucumber, chilli and coriander.
notes: Pickled carrot keeps 5 days in the fridge.
Contains gluten and soy.

recipes.title: Prawn Rice Paper Rolls (with Hoisin Peanut Sauce)
recipes.summary: Cold fresh rolls of prawn, vermicelli, lettuce and herbs with a quick dipping sauce.
steps: Soak the vermicelli in boiling water for 4 minutes, drain and cool.
Soften one wrapper at a time in warm water for 10 seconds, lay on a board and layer lettuce, noodles, carrot, cucumber, mint and 3 prawn halves.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly until firm.
Whisk the hoisin, peanut butter, lime juice and water into a sauce and serve with the rolls.
notes: Food safety: cook only cooked prawns bought fresh and kept cold until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only). Eat within 24 hours; keep covered with damp paper towel and chilled below 5C.
Contains crustacean shellfish, peanuts and soy.

recipes.title: Tofu and Mango Rice Paper Rolls (Vegan)
recipes.summary: Fresh rolls of baked tofu, mango, herbs and crunchy vegetables with a lime and chilli dip.
steps: Pat the tofu dry and season with a little of the soy sauce.
Soften one wrapper at a time in warm water for 10 seconds and layer lettuce, tofu, mango, carrot, cucumber and coriander.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly until each roll holds its shape.
Stir the remaining soy sauce with the lime juice, chilli and sugar for dipping.
notes: Eat within 24 hours; keep covered and chilled.
Contains soy.

recipes.title: Salmon Avocado Rice Paper Rolls
recipes.summary: Hot-smoked style flaked salmon with avocado and cucumber in fresh rice paper rolls.
steps: Season the salmon and bake at 200C for 10 minutes until opaque and flaking; cool and flake.
Soften one wrapper at a time in warm water and layer lettuce, salmon, avocado, cucumber and carrot.
Roll tightly, tucking in the sides.
Mix the soy sauce, lime juice and sesame oil with the sesame seeds for dipping.
notes: Food safety: cook salmon until opaque and flaking all the way through until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only). Chill within 1 hour and eat within 24 hours; keep below 5C.
Contains fish, soy and sesame.

recipes.title: Tofu Poke Bowl (Vegan Soy-Sesame Tofu on Rice)
recipes.summary: Marinated tofu cubes over sushi rice with edamame, cucumber, avocado and pickled ginger.
steps: Rinse the rice and simmer with 1.5 cups water, covered, for 12 minutes until the water is absorbed, then season with a pinch of salt.
Toss the tofu with the soy sauce, sesame oil and vinegar while the rice cooks.
Boil the edamame for 3 minutes and drain.
Divide the rice into bowls and top with tofu, edamame, cucumber, avocado, ginger, sesame and spring onion.
notes: Keeps 2 days in the fridge.
Contains soy and sesame.

recipes.title: Chicken Poke-Style Bowl (Teriyaki, Cucumber and Pineapple)
recipes.summary: Teriyaki chicken strips on rice with pineapple, cucumber, edamame and sesame mayo.
steps: Simmer the rice with 1.5 cups water, covered, for 12 minutes until tender.
Fry the chicken in the oil over medium-high heat for 7 minutes until cooked through (75°C), add the teriyaki sauce and toss for 1 minute until glazed.
Mix the mayonnaise and sesame oil.
Serve the rice topped with chicken, pineapple, cucumber, edamame, sesame mayo and sesame seeds.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken until cooked through, no pink at the centre until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only). Pack rice and chicken chilled within 1 hour; eat within 3 days.
Contains egg, soy and sesame.

recipes.title: Vegan Burrito Bowl (Sweet Potato and Black Bean)
recipes.summary: Roasted sweet potato, spiced black beans and rice with corn salsa and avocado.
steps: Roast the sweet potato with the paprika and oil at 220C for 25 minutes until tender and caramelised.
Cook the rice in 2 cups water for 12 minutes and warm the beans with the cumin.
Mix the corn, tomato, onion, lime juice and coriander into a salsa.
Build bowls with rice, sweet potato, beans, salsa and avocado.
notes: Keeps 3 days in the fridge; add the avocado fresh.
Check labels on canned goods for gluten.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken Meal Prep Bowl (with Rice and Tzatziki)
recipes.summary: Oregano and lemon chicken with rice, cucumber, tomato and tzatziki, packed for the week.
steps: Toss the chicken with the oil, oregano, lemon juice, garlic and salt, then roast at 200C for 22 minutes until cooked through (75°C); rest and slice.
Cook the rice in 3 cups water for 12 minutes.
Grate half the cucumber into the yoghurt with the dill and a pinch of salt.
Pack the rice, chicken, tomato, remaining cucumber, onion and tzatziki into 4 containers.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken to 75C throughout until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only).  Cool within 1 hour, refrigerate below 5C and eat within 3 days; cool rice quickly and reheat once until steaming hot.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Beef Taco Meal Prep Bowls (with Rice and Corn)
recipes.summary: Spiced beef mince over rice with beans, corn and salsa, divided into containers.
steps: Cook the rice in 3 cups water for 12 minutes.
Brown the onion in the oil, add the mince and seasoning and cook for 10 minutes until browned all through (75°C).
Mix the tomato, corn, lime juice and coriander for a salsa.
Divide the rice, beef, beans and salsa into 4 containers.
notes: Food safety: cook mince until browned and no pink remains until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only).  Cool within 1 hour and eat within 3 days; reheat until steaming hot.
Check the taco seasoning label for gluten.

recipes.title: Chickpea Tikka Masala Meal Prep Boxes
recipes.summary: A creamy tomato chickpea curry with rice and spinach, packed for four lunches.
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, add the garam masala and paprika and fry for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer for 12 minutes, then stir in the cream and spinach.
Cook the rice in 3 cups water for 12 minutes.
Simmer the curry until thick, then divide the rice and curry into 4 containers and top with coriander.
notes: Cool quickly and refrigerate within 1 hour; eat within 3 days and reheat until steaming hot.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Egg and Veg Muffin Cups (High-Protein Meal Prep)
recipes.summary: Baked egg cups with spinach, capsicum and feta, ready for grab-and-go lunches.
steps: Heat the oven to 180C and grease a 12-hole muffin tin with the oil.
Whisk the eggs, milk and salt, then stir in the spinach, capsicum, spring onion and feta.
Pour into the holes and bake 20 to 22 minutes until set in the middle.
Cool and pack three per lunch.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg cups until set in the centre until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only). Cool within 1 hour and refrigerate; eat within 3 days and reheat until steaming hot.
Contains egg and milk.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Chicken Meal Prep Boxes (with Broccoli and Rice)
recipes.summary: Glazed chicken thigh with steamed broccoli and rice, a simple weekday lunch.
steps: Cook the rice in 3 cups water for 12 minutes.
Brown the chicken in the oil for 8 minutes until cooked through (75°C), add the teriyaki sauce and cook 2 minutes until glossy.
Steam the broccoli for 4 minutes.
Divide into 4 containers and finish with sesame seeds and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken until no pink remains until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only).  Cool within 1 hour, keep below 5C and eat within 3 days; reheat until steaming hot.
Contains soy and sesame.

recipes.title: Lentil Bolognese Meal Prep Boxes (Vegan)
recipes.summary: Rich brown lentil and mushroom ragu over wholemeal pasta, made to be batch-cooked.
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and mushroom in the oil for 8 minutes with the garlic.
Add the lentils, passata, stock and oregano and simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Boil the pasta until al dente and drain.
Divide into 4 containers and top with the lentil sauce.
notes: Cool within 1 hour and eat within 4 days; freezes well.
Contains gluten.

recipes.title: Tuna and White Bean Meal Prep Boxes
recipes.summary: Canned tuna with white beans, tomato, red onion and a lemon dressing over baby leaves.

items: 425g canned tuna in olive oil, drained

steps: Mix the beans, tomato and onion in a bowl until evenly combined.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice, oregano and salt and stir through.
Fold in the tuna in large flakes and the parsley.
Pack into 4 containers over rocket, adding the leaves when ready to eat.
notes: Food safety: cook canned tuna only from a freshly opened can until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only).  Keep below 5C and eat within 2 days; do not leave out for more than 2 hours.
Contains fish.
